extracted.name: Tourtière (Meat Pie) Spices
extracted.description: A blend of spices used in the traditional French-Canadian tourtière (meat pie). I use beef, pork, and veal, but this meat pie spice mix goes with any combination.
instruction_lines: Combine celery salt, pepper, savory, cloves, cinnamon, thyme, sage, and mustard powder in a small bowl. Mix well and store in a sealed jar.
